#xr-root .intro {
  flex: none;
  border-bottom: var(--divider-width) solid var(--divider);
  background: var(--surface);
  overflow: clip;
  transform-origin: top left;
  position: sticky;
  top: 0;
  z-index: 4;
  --intro-padding: 12px;
  padding: var(--intro-padding) 20px;
  --heading: var(--chrome-ink);
  --control-ink: var(--chrome-ink);
  --muted: var(--chrome-ink);
  --dim: var(--chrome-ink);
  color: var(--chrome-ink);
  border-bottom-color: var(--chrome-line);
  background-color: rgb(from var(--surface) r g b / 1);
}
#xr-root .intro-flow {
  display: grid;
  align-items: end;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1fr) auto;
  gap: 6px 12px;
}
#xr-root .intro-flow, #xr-root .masthead, #xr-root .intro-heading, #xr-root .intro-tools, #xr-root .intro-meta {
  transform-origin: top left;
}
@container xr-window (min-width: 768px) {
  #xr-root .app:has(.bento-canvas:not([data-open="overview"])) .intro {
    --intro-padding: 8px;
  }
  #xr-root .app:has(.bento-canvas:not([data-open="overview"])) :is(.intro-note,.intro-meta,.edition,.canvas-tag,.save-indicator) {
    display: none;
  }
  #xr-root .app:has(.bento-canvas:not([data-open="overview"])) #canvas-status {
    min-height: 0;
    white-space: nowrap;
    font-size: 11px;
  }
}
#xr-root .intro-tools {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: flex-end;
  min-width: 0;
  gap: 4px;
}
#xr-root .intro-meta {
  grid-column: 1 / -1;
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 8px 18px;
  min-width: 0;
  color: var(--muted);
  font-size: 10px;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
#xr-root .intro-meta kbd {
  font-size: 10px;
  padding: 1px 4px;
  color: inherit;
}
#xr-root .intro-note {
  color: var(--muted);
  margin-top: 0;
  font-size: 12px;
}
#xr-root .edition {
  text-align: right;
  color: var(--muted);
  font-size: 10px;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
  line-height: 1.9;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
#xr-root .canvas-toolbar {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  justify-content: flex-end;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  width: auto;
}
#xr-root .canvas-state {
  min-width: 0;
  display: block;
}
#xr-root .canvas-tag {
  border: 2px solid currentColor;
  color: var(--muted);
  font: 700 11px/1.6 var(--font-body);
  letter-spacing: .06em;
  padding: 4px 7px;
}
#xr-root .bento-canvas {
  position: relative;
  isolation: isolate;
  display: grid;
  flex: 1;
  min-height: 720px;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));
  grid-template-rows: repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));
  grid-template-areas: "mode compose" "styles scene" "preview archives";
  gap: var(--divider-width);
  background: var(--divider);
}

/* 模块卡片 */
#xr-root .bento-canvas:not([data-open="overview"]) {
  grid-template-columns: clamp(56px,5vw,80px) minmax(0,1fr);
  grid-template-rows: repeat(5,minmax(44px,1fr));
  grid-template-areas: none;
}
#xr-root .bento-canvas:not([data-open="overview"]) > .bento-tile {
  grid-area: auto;
  grid-column: 1;
}
#xr-root .bento-canvas:not([data-open="overview"]) > .bento-tile.is-open {
  grid-column: 2;
  grid-row: 1 / -1;
}
#xr-root .panel-surface {
  position: absolute;
  z-index: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  background: var(--surface);
  transform-origin: top left;
}
#xr-root .bento-canvas.is-moving > .bento-tile {
  background: transparent;
}
#xr-root .bento-tile {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
  --panel-accent: var(--xr-emphasis-ink);
  --control-ink: var(--heading);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  min-width: 0;
  min-height: 0;
  background: var(--surface);
  container-type: size;
  overflow: hidden;
  scroll-margin-top: 12px;
  transform-origin: top left;
}
#xr-root .bento-tile.is-open {
  --control-ink: var(--panel-accent);
}
#xr-root .bento-tile:not(.is-open) {
  cursor: pointer;
}
#xr-root .bento-canvas:not([data-open="overview"]) > .bento-tile:not(.is-open):not(:hover):not(:focus-within) {
  --heading: var(--dim);
  --control-ink: var(--dim);
  --muted: var(--dim);
}
#xr-root .bento-tile[data-bento-panel="compose"] {
  grid-area: compose;
}
#xr-root .bento-tile[data-bento-panel="mode"] {
  grid-area: mode;
}
#xr-root .bento-tile[data-bento-panel="styles"] {
  grid-area: styles;
}
#xr-root .bento-tile[data-bento-panel="scene"] {
  grid-area: scene;
}
#xr-root .bento-tile[data-bento-panel="preview"] {
  grid-area: preview;
}
#xr-root .bento-tile[data-bento-panel="archives"] {
  grid-area: archives;
}
#xr-root .tile-heading {
  flex: none;
  padding: 26px 28px 12px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 16px;
}
#xr-root .tile-heading-actions {
  display: flex;
  flex: none;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: flex-end;
  gap: 12px;
  margin-left: auto;
}
#xr-root .bento-tile:not(.is-open) .tile-heading-actions > [data-ui-help] {
  display: none;
}
#xr-root .tile-primary-action {
  display: none;
  border-width: 3px;
}
#xr-root .bento-tile.is-open .tile-primary-action {
  display: inline-flex;
}
#xr-root .tile-title {
  min-width: 0;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 14px;
}
#xr-root .tile-number {
  align-self: flex-start;
  flex: none;
  padding: 4px 6px;
  border: 3px solid currentColor;
  color: var(--dim);
  font: 700 clamp(40px,8cqw,56px)/1 var(--font-display);
  letter-spacing: -.04em;
}
#xr-root .tile-heading h2 {
  max-width: 100%;
  font-size: clamp(28px,5.8cqw,40px);
  line-height: 1.15;
  letter-spacing: -.02em;
  white-space: nowrap;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
}
#xr-root .tile-toggle {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 7px;
  background: transparent;
  border: 0;
  padding: 4px 0;
  color: var(--control-ink);
  font-size: 12px;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
#xr-root .tile-toggle .icon {
  width: 24px;
  height: 24px;
}
#xr-root .tile-heading:has(.tile-toggle:focus-visible) {
  outline: 2px solid currentColor;
  outline-offset: -3px;
}
#xr-root .tile-peek {
  display: flex;
  flex: 1;
  min-height: 0;
  width: 100%;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: stretch;
  text-align: left;
  border: 0;
  background: transparent;
  padding: 0 28px 18px;
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  font-weight: 400;
  overflow: hidden;
}
#xr-root .tile-peek:focus-visible {
  outline-offset: -4px;
}
#xr-root .peek-label {
  display: block;
  font: 500 11px/1.4 var(--font-body);
  color: var(--muted);
  letter-spacing: .06em;
}
#xr-root .peek-value {
  display: -webkit-box;
  flex: none;
  -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
  -webkit-line-clamp: 1;
  overflow: hidden;
  color: var(--heading);
  font: 700 clamp(18px,3.4cqw,23px)/1.35 var(--font-display);
  letter-spacing: -.02em;
  margin: 6px 0;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
#xr-root .peek-body {
  display: -webkit-box;
  -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
  -webkit-line-clamp: 1;
  overflow: hidden;
  font-size: clamp(15.2px,1.1vw,17.6px);
  font-weight: 400;
  color: var(--muted);
  line-height: 1.7;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
#xr-root .tile-detail {
  flex: 1;
  min-height: 0;
  overflow-y: auto;
  overflow-x: hidden;
  overscroll-behavior: contain;
  overscroll-behavior-y: auto;
  background: var(--surface);
  --xr-frame-outer: rgba(128, 128, 128, .24);
  --xr-frame-middle: rgba(128, 128, 128, .44);
  --xr-frame-inner: rgba(128, 128, 128, .72);
}
#xr-root .tile-detail:focus {
  outline: none;
}
#xr-root .tile-content {
  display: flow-root;
}
#xr-root .tile-heading, #xr-root .tile-heading-actions, #xr-root .tile-toggle, #xr-root .tile-peek, #xr-root .tile-detail, #xr-root .tile-content {
  transform-origin: top left;
}
#xr-root .detail-heading {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  justify-content: space-between;
}
#xr-root .detail-heading h3 {
  line-height: 1.2;
  letter-spacing: -.02em;
}
#xr-root .detail-heading p, #xr-root .muted {
  font-size: 14px;
  color: var(--muted);
  margin-top: 10px;
}

/* 输入框 */
#xr-root .fields-grid {
  display: grid;
}
#xr-root #detail-compose :is(#mode-fields,#advanced-fields) {
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(min(100%, 300px), 1fr));
}
#xr-root .field {
  min-width: 0;
}
#xr-root .field-head {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 10px;
  margin-bottom: 7px;
}
#xr-root .field-head label, #xr-root .field-head b, #xr-root .field-head h2, #xr-root .field-head h3, #xr-root .field-label {
  font-size: 16px;
  font-weight: 700;
}
#xr-root .field-label {
  display: block;
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}
#xr-root textarea, #xr-root input[type="text"], #xr-root input[type="number"], #xr-root select {
  width: 100%;
  min-width: 0;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  background: var(--input);
  padding: 12px 13px;
  font-size: 16px;
  font-weight: 400;
  line-height: 1.7;
}
#xr-root textarea {
  min-height: 84px;
  resize: vertical;
  display: block;
}
#xr-root textarea::placeholder, #xr-root input::placeholder {
  color: var(--muted) !important;
  opacity: .55 !important;
}
#xr-root textarea, #xr-root input, #xr-root select {
  color: var(--ink) !important;
  caret-color: var(--ink);
}
#xr-root select option {
  color: var(--ink);
  background: var(--input);
}
#xr-root small {
  color: var(--muted) !important;
  opacity: 1 !important;
}
#xr-root b, #xr-root strong {
  color: inherit !important;
}
#xr-root textarea:focus, #xr-root input:focus, #xr-root select:focus {
  background: var(--surface);
}
#xr-root .field-lock {
  display: inline-flex;
  gap: 5px;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  border: 1px solid currentColor;
  background: transparent;
  padding: 4px 7px;
  font-size: 11px;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
#xr-root .field-lock .icon {
  width: 13px;
  height: 13px;
}
#xr-root .field-lock[aria-pressed="true"] {
  outline: 1px solid currentColor;
  outline-offset: -2px;
}
#xr-root details {
  margin-top: 22px;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--hairline);
  padding-top: 16px;
}
#xr-root summary {
  cursor: pointer;
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: var(--muted);
  width: fit-content;
}
#xr-root details[open] > summary {
  margin-bottom: 17px;
  color: var(--ink);
}
#xr-root :is(.narrative-settings, #optional-fields) {
  margin: 16px 0 22px;
}
#xr-root :is(.narrative-settings, #optional-fields) > summary {
  min-height: 44px;
  padding: 8px 0;
  font-size: 18px;
  line-height: 1.5;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--ink);
}
#xr-root .settings-grid {
  display: grid;
}
#xr-root #xr-narrative-settings>.xr-group {
  grid-column: 1/-1;
}
#xr-root .editor-bottom {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 16px;
  margin: 24px 0 18px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}
#xr-root .input-count {
  color: var(--muted);
  font-size: 11px;
}
#xr-root .text-actions {
  display: flex;
  gap: 18px;
}

/* 文风选择 */
#xr-root .mode-tabs {
  display: grid;
}
#xr-root .mode-tab {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1fr) 18px;
  align-items: start;
  width: 100%;
  text-align: left;
  border: 2px solid currentColor;
  background: transparent;
}
#xr-root .mode-tab > .icon:first-child {
  grid-column: 1;
  grid-row: 1;
}
#xr-root .mode-tab > span {
  grid-column: 1 / -1;
  grid-row: 2;
}
#xr-root .mode-tab > .selected-check {
  grid-column: 2;
  grid-row: 1;
  align-self: center;
}
#xr-root .mode-tab:hover strong, #xr-root .style-preset:hover strong {
  text-decoration: underline;
  text-underline-offset: 4px;
}
#xr-root .mode-tab[aria-selected="true"], #xr-root .style-preset[aria-pressed="true"] {
  outline: 2px solid currentColor;
  outline-offset: -2px;
  box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 currentColor;
}
#xr-root .mode-tab strong {
  display: block;
  font-size: 18px;
}
#xr-root .mode-tab[aria-selected="true"] .selected-check {
  visibility: visible;
}
#xr-root .policy-note {
  margin-inline: 0;
  background: var(--subtle);
  border-left: 2px solid var(--line);
  font-size: 12px;
  color: var(--muted);
}
#xr-root .policy-note strong {
  display: block;
  color: var(--ink);
  margin-bottom: 5px;
}
#xr-root .page-actions, #xr-root .dialog-actions {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 13px;
  align-items: center;
}
#xr-root .style-presets {
  display: grid;
  margin-inline: 0;
}
#xr-root .style-preset {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  background: transparent;
  border: 2px solid currentColor;
  text-align: left;
  min-width: 0;
}
#xr-root .style-preset > span {
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 0;
}
#xr-root .style-preset strong {
  display: block;
  font-size: 18px;
  text-wrap: balance;
}
#xr-root .selected-check {
  visibility: hidden;
}
#xr-root [aria-pressed="true"] .selected-check {
  visibility: visible;
}
#xr-root .external-style-field {
  padding-top: 20px;
  margin-top: 21px;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--hairline);
}
#xr-root [data-nsfw-style-panel] > .xr-binary + .field-label {
  margin-top: 16px;
}
#xr-root .external-style-field p {
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--muted);
  margin-top: 8px;
}
#xr-root .badge {
  display: inline-block;
  background: var(--subtle);
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  color: var(--muted);
  padding: 3px 7px;
  font-size: 10px;
}
#xr-root .disclaimer {
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--muted);
  line-height: 1.8;
  margin-top: 15px;
}
#xr-root .card {
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  padding: 20px;
  background: var(--input);
}
#xr-root .archive-list {
  display: grid;
  gap: 18px;
  margin-top: 21px;
}
#xr-root .archive-head {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 14px;
  align-items: flex-start;
}
#xr-root .archive-head h2 {
  font-size: 15px;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
#xr-root .archive-excerpt {
  margin: 13px 0;
  font-size: 12px;
  white-space: pre-wrap;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
  color: var(--muted);
}
#xr-root .archive-card .page-actions {
  border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
  padding-top: 13px;
  justify-content: space-between;
}
#xr-root kbd {
  font: 11px/1.4 ui-monospace, Consolas, monospace;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  padding: 2px 5px;
  background: var(--subtle);
}
#xr-root dialog {
  width: min(580px,calc(100% - 32px));
  max-height: calc(100svh - 40px);
  padding: 0;
  background: var(--surface);
  color: var(--ink);
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
}
#xr-root dialog::backdrop {
  background: rgb(0 0 0 / .78);
}
#xr-root .dialog-content {
  padding: 25px;
}
#xr-root .dialog-header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 20px;
  margin-bottom: 19px;
}
#xr-root .dialog-header h2 {
  font-size: 22px;
  line-height: 1.5;
}
#xr-root .dialog-content p, #xr-root .dialog-content li {
  color: var(--muted);
  font-size: 12px;
  line-height: 1.95;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
#xr-root .dialog-content p {
  margin: 10px 0;
}
#xr-root .dialog-content ul {
  padding-left: 19px;
}
#xr-root .dialog-actions {
  justify-content: flex-end;
  margin-top: 22px;
  padding-top: 18px;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--hairline);
}
#xr-root .dialog-status {
  padding: 10px;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  background: var(--subtle);
}
@container (max-width: 590px) {
  #xr-root .detail-heading {
    flex-wrap: wrap;
  }
  #xr-root .bento-tile.is-open .tile-heading:has(.tile-primary-action) {
    flex-wrap: wrap;
  }
}
@container (max-height: 280px) {
  #xr-root .peek-body {
    display: none;
  }
}
@container (max-width: 260px) {
  #xr-root .tile-heading {
    padding: 12px;
    gap: 8px;
  }
  #xr-root .tile-title {
    flex-direction: row;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
  }
  #xr-root .tile-number {
    font-size: 22px;
  }
  #xr-root .tile-heading h2 {
    font-size: 16px;
  }
  #xr-root .toggle-label {
    display: none;
  }
  #xr-root .tile-toggle .icon {
    width: 18px;
    height: 18px;
  }
  #xr-root .tile-peek {
    padding: 12px;
  }
  #xr-root .peek-value {
    font-size: 18px;
  }
}
@container (max-height: 170px) {
  #xr-root .tile-peek {
    padding: 10px 14px;
  }
  #xr-root .peek-label {
    display: none;
  }
  #xr-root .peek-value {
    font-size: 18px;
    margin: 0;
    -webkit-line-clamp: 2;
  }
  #xr-root .tile-heading {
    min-height: 48px;
    padding: 10px 14px;
    gap: 8px;
    align-items: center;
  }
  #xr-root .tile-title {
    flex-direction: row;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
  }
  #xr-root .tile-number {
    font-size: 26px;
  }
  #xr-root .tile-heading h2 {
    font-size: 18px;
  }
  #xr-root .tile-toggle .icon {
    width: 18px;
    height: 18px;
  }
}
@container xr-window (max-width: 1000px) {
  #xr-root .edition, #xr-root .save-indicator {
    display: none;
  }
}
@container xr-window (min-width: 768px) {
  #xr-root .bento-canvas:not([data-open="overview"]) .bento-tile:not(.is-open) .tile-heading {
    height: 100%;
    min-height: 0;
    padding: 6px;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 0;
  }
  #xr-root .bento-canvas:not([data-open="overview"]) .bento-tile:not(.is-open) .tile-title {
    position: absolute;
    left: 50%;
    top: 50%;
    width: max-content;
    max-width: calc(100cqh - 12px);
    flex-direction: row;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 5px;
    transform: translate(-50%,-50%) rotate(90deg);
    transform-origin: center;
    writing-mode: horizontal-tb;
    text-orientation: mixed;
  }
  #xr-root .bento-canvas:not([data-open="overview"]) .bento-tile:not(.is-open) .tile-number {
    align-self: center;
    font-size: clamp(10px,10cqh,14px);
    padding: 1px 2px;
    border-width: 2px;
  }
  #xr-root .bento-canvas:not([data-open="overview"]) .bento-tile:not(.is-open) .tile-heading h2 {
    min-width: 0;
    flex: 1;
    writing-mode: horizontal-tb;
    text-orientation: mixed;
    font-size: clamp(10px,11cqh,18px);
    line-height: 1.2;
    letter-spacing: .03em;
    white-space: nowrap;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
  }
  #xr-root .bento-canvas:not([data-open="overview"]) .bento-tile:not(.is-open) .tile-toggle {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    display: block;

function xrHelpText(id, values = {}) {
  const key = id.startsWith('inline.') ? id : 'inline.' + id;
  if (!Object.hasOwn(XR_HELP_TEXT, key)) throw new Error('帮助文案不存在：' + id);
  return String(XR_HELP_TEXT[key]).replace(/【([^】]+)】/g, (match, name) =>

}

function standaloneLexicalApi(name) {
  switch (name) {
    case 'createOrReplaceWorldbook': return typeof createOrReplaceWorldbook === 'function' ? createOrReplaceWorldbook : null;
    case 'deleteWorldbook': return typeof deleteWorldbook === 'function' ? deleteWorldbook : null;
    case 'eventMakeLast': return typeof eventMakeLast === 'function' ? eventMakeLast : null;
    case 'eventOn': return typeof eventOn === 'function' ? eventOn : null;
    case 'eventOnButton': return typeof eventOnButton === 'function' ? eventOnButton : null;
    case 'getButtonEvent': return typeof getButtonEvent === 'function' ? getButtonEvent : null;
    case 'setChatMessages': return typeof setChatMessages === 'function' ? setChatMessages : null;
    case 'getWorldbook': return typeof getWorldbook === 'function' ? getWorldbook : null;
    case 'getWorldbookNames': return typeof getWorldbookNames === 'function' ? getWorldbookNames : null;
    case 'refreshHelperWorldbooks': return typeof refreshHelperWorldbooks === 'function' ? refreshHelperWorldbooks : null;
    default: return null;
  }
}

function createTavernAdapter(localWindow = window, apiScope = globalThis, lexicalApi = standaloneLexicalApi) {
  let hostWindow, hostDocument, hostJQuery, eventOwner, eventBus;
  const apiCache = new Map();
  const requiredEvents = ['GENERATION_STARTED', 'GENERATION_AFTER_COMMANDS', 'CHAT_COMPLETION_SETTINGS_READY',
    'GENERATION_ENDED', 'GENERATION_STOPPED'];

  function invalidate() {
    hostWindow = hostDocument = hostJQuery = eventOwner = eventBus = null;
    apiCache.clear();
  }

  function host() {
    if (hostWindow) {
      try {
        if (!hostWindow.closed && hostWindow.document === hostDocument) return hostWindow;
      } catch (_) {}
      invalidate();
    }
    let current = localWindow;
    for (let depth = 0; depth < 8; depth++) {
      try {
        if (current.parent === current || !current.parent?.document?.documentElement) break;
        current = current.parent;
      } catch (_) { break; }
    }
    hostWindow = current;
    try { hostDocument = current.document || localWindow.document; }
    catch (_) { hostDocument = localWindow.document; }
    return hostWindow;
  }

  function document() {
    host();
    return hostDocument;
  }

  function jquery() {
    const owner = host();
    if (hostJQuery) return hostJQuery;
    try { hostJQuery = owner.jQuery || owner.$ || null; } catch (_) {}
    if (!hostJQuery) {
      try { hostJQuery = typeof jQuery === 'function' ? jQuery : typeof $ === 'function' ? $ : null; } catch (_) {}
    }
    return hostJQuery;
  }

  function storage() {
    try { if (host().localStorage) return hostWindow.localStorage; } catch (_) {}
    try { return apiScope.localStorage || null; } catch (_) { return null; }
  }

  function api(name) {
    const lexical = lexicalApi(name);
    let owner = null, callable = lexical;
    if (!callable) {
      try {
        if (typeof apiScope[name] === 'function') { owner = apiScope; callable = owner[name]; }
      } catch (_) {}
      if (!callable) {
        try {
          if (typeof apiScope.TavernHelper?.[name] === 'function') { owner = apiScope.TavernHelper; callable = owner[name]; }
        } catch (_) {}
      }
    }
    if (typeof callable !== 'function') { apiCache.delete(name); return null; }
    const cached = apiCache.get(name);
    if (cached?.callable === callable && cached.owner === owner) return cached.bound;
    const bound = owner ? callable.bind(owner) : callable;
    apiCache.set(name, {owner, callable, bound});
    return bound;
  }

  function readContext(owner) {
    try { return owner.SillyTavern?.getContext?.() || null; } catch (_) { return null; }
  }

  function readEvents(owner) {
    try {
      const context = readContext(owner), st = owner.SillyTavern;
      const source = context?.eventSource || owner.eventSource;
      const types = context?.event_types || context?.eventTypes || st?.event_types || st?.eventTypes || owner.event_types || owner.eventTypes;
      if (!source || typeof source.on !== 'function' ||
          typeof source.removeListener !== 'function' && typeof source.off !== 'function' ||
          !types || !requiredEvents.every(name => types[name])) return null;
      if (!eventBus || eventBus.source !== source || eventBus.types !== types) {
        eventBus = {source, types, context, window: source.on.constructor('return window')()};
      } else eventBus.context = context;
      eventOwner = owner;
      return eventBus;
    } catch (_) { return null; }
  }

  function events() {
    host();
    if (eventOwner) {
      const cached = readEvents(eventOwner);
      if (cached) return cached;
      eventOwner = eventBus = null;
    }
    const seen = new Set();
    let current = localWindow;
    while (current && !seen.has(current)) {
      seen.add(current);
      const found = readEvents(current);
      if (found) return found;
      try { current = current.parent === current ? null : current.parent; } catch (_) { break; }
    }
    return seen.has(hostWindow) ? null : readEvents(hostWindow);
  }

  function context() {
    return events()?.context || readContext(localWindow) || readContext(host());
  }

  return {host, document, jquery, storage, api, events, context, invalidate};
}

function createSettingsStore() {
  // Community edition: native account storage persists on the server and isolates users.
  // Never use the origin-wide localStorage for account writing preferences.
  const storage = getSTContextSafe()?.accountStorage;
  const document = {preferences: stateNormalizePreferences({}), workflow: normalizeWorkflowConfig({})};
  const dirty = new Set();
  let raw, readError = '', saveError = '';
  function refresh() {
    try {
      if (!storage) throw new Error('存储不可用');
      const next = storage.getItem(SAVE_KEY) ?? null;
      if (next !== raw) {
        const parsed = next ? JSON.parse(next) : {};
        if (!parsed || typeof parsed !== 'object' || Array.isArray(parsed)) throw new Error('配置格式错误');
        if (!dirty.has('preferences')) {
          Object.assign(document.preferences, stateNormalizePreferences(parsed.preferences));
        }
        if (!dirty.has('workflow')) document.workflow = normalizeWorkflowConfig(parsed.workflow);
        raw = next;
      }
      readError = '';
    } catch (_) {
      readError = xrHelpText(storage ? 'settings.storage.readerror' : 'settings.storage.absent');
    }
    return document;
  }
  function stage(section, value) {
    if (section === 'preferences') Object.assign(document.preferences, value);
    else document.workflow = isoClone(value);
    dirty.add(section);
  }
  function write(section, value) {
    stage(section, value);
    // Merge untouched sections from storage before replacing the shared document.
    refresh();
    if (readError) return false;
    try {
      const next = JSON.stringify({preferences: statePreferenceSnapshot(document.preferences), workflow: document.workflow});
      if (next !== raw) storage.setItem(SAVE_KEY, next);
      raw = next;
      dirty.clear();
      readError = saveError = '';
      return true;
    } catch (_) {
      saveError = '设置已在本会话生效，但未保存到账号；刷新后可能丢失。';
      return false;
    }
  }
  refresh();
  return {read: () => document, refresh, write,
    shouldInitialize: () => raw === null && !readError && dirty.size === 0,
    error: () => saveError || readError};
}

function stateNormalizePreferences(value) {
  const defaults = blankState(), result = {};
  for (const [key, fallback] of Object.entries(defaults)) {
    const saved = value?.[key];
    const valid = typeof saved === typeof fallback && (typeof fallback !== 'object' || saved && !Array.isArray(saved));
    result[key] = isoClone(valid ? saved : fallback);
  }
  for (const field of NARRATIVE_CHOICE_FIELDS) {
    if (!Object.hasOwn(field.options, result[field.key])) result[field.key] = defaults[field.key];
  }
  if (!MODES[result.mode]) result.mode = defaults.mode;
  if (!['RP', 'CONVERSATION'].includes(result.directMode)) result.directMode = defaults.directMode;
  if (!['FIRST', 'SECOND'].includes(result.actorPov)) result.actorPov = defaults.actorPov;
  for (const mode of ORDER) {
    const saved = result.stylesByMode[mode];
    result.stylesByMode[mode] = saved && STYLE_MAIN_OPTIONS[saved.main]
      ? {main: saved.main, customText: typeof saved.customText === 'string' ? saved.customText : ''}
      : defaults.stylesByMode[mode];
  }
  result.uiTheme = ['DARK', 'LIGHT', 'THEME'].includes(value && value.uiTheme) ? value.uiTheme : 'DARK';
  result.povMode = ['FLOW_DEFAULT', 'PROTAG_FIRST', 'PROTAG_SECOND', 'PROTAG_THIRD', 'SUPPORT_FIRST', 'SUPPORT_THIRD']
    .includes(value && value.povMode) ? value.povMode : 'FLOW_DEFAULT';
  result.suggestedActionsCount = suggestNormalizeCount(value?.suggestedActionsCount);
  return result;
}

function normalizeWorkflowConfig(value) {
  const result = xrMultiUiDefaults();
  for (const [key, field] of Object.entries(XR_WORKFLOW_FIELDS)) {
    const saved = value?.[key];
    if (field.type === 'switch') result[key] = Number(saved === 1);
    else if (field.type === 'text') result[key] = typeof saved === 'string' ? saved : field.value;
    else if (field.type === 'selection') {
      let entries = saved;
      if (typeof entries === 'string') {
        try { entries = JSON.parse(entries); } catch (_) { entries = []; }
      }
      result[key] = Array.isArray(entries) ? [...new Set(entries.filter(id => typeof id === 'string' && id.trim()))] : [];
    }
    else if (field.type === 'number') result[key] = Number.isFinite(saved)
      ? Math.min(field.max, Math.max(field.min, Math.round(saved))) : field.value;
  }
  delete result.multiStepEnabled;
  return result;
}

function stateFlushMetadata() {
    if (STATE_PREF_SAVE_TIMER) clearTimeout(STATE_PREF_SAVE_TIMER);
    STATE_PREF_SAVE_TIMER = null;
    const pending = STATE_METADATA_PENDING;
    if (!pending) return false;
    const current = getSTContextSafe();
    // The host saves the current global chat; an old context cannot target another chat.
    if (!current || current.chatMetadata !== pending.meta) {
      STATE_METADATA_PENDING = null;
      return false;
    }
    if (typeof pending.context.saveMetadata !== 'function') return false;
    STATE_METADATA_PENDING = null;
    function failed(error) {
      // Keep dirty metadata for the next explicit flush without replacing newer edits.
      if (!STATE_METADATA_PENDING && isoCurrentMetadata() === pending.meta) STATE_METADATA_PENDING = pending;
      console.warn('[剑仙RE] saveMetadata failed', error);
    }
    try {
      const result = pending.context.saveMetadata();

    let cursor = at;
    lines.forEach(function (line, lineIndex) {
      const start = full.indexOf(line, cursor);
      if (start !== cursor) xrEditFail('行动块行结构不正确', 'INVALID_RESPONSE');
      if (lineIndex >= 3 && lineIndex < lines.length - 1) {
        const prefix = 'OPTION_' + (lineIndex - 2) + '=';
        if (!line.startsWith(prefix) || !line.slice(prefix.length).trim() || line.slice(prefix.length) !== line.slice(prefix.length).trim())
          xrEditFail('行动编号或文字格式不正确', 'INVALID_RESPONSE');
        actions.push(line.slice(prefix.length)); actionOffsets.push(start + prefix.length);
      }
      cursor = start + line.length;
      if (full.slice(cursor, cursor + 2) === '
') cursor += 2; else if (full[cursor] === '
') cursor += 1;
    });
  } else if (spec.enabled) xrEditFail('正文缺少已开启的行动块', 'INVALID_RESPONSE');
  if (!body.trim()) xrEditFail('正文为空', 'INVALID_RESPONSE');
  return {full: full, body: body, actions: actions, actionOffsets: actionOffsets,
    draftId: 'draft-' + hash32(full)};
}

function xrEditLocate(draft, target, index, quote, occurrence) {
  let text, offset;
  if (target === 'body' && index === 0) { text = draft.body; offset = 0; }
  else if (target === 'action' && Number.isSafeInteger(index) && index >= 1 && index <= draft.actions.length) {
    text = draft.actions[index - 1]; offset = draft.actionOffsets[index - 1];
  } else xrEditFail('修改目标不是当前正文或有效行动文字', 'EDIT_LOCATION');
  if (typeof quote !== 'string' || !quote || !Number.isSafeInteger(occurrence) || occurrence < 1)
    xrEditFail('原句或出现次数无效', 'EDIT_LOCATION');
  let found = -1, count = 0;
  while ((found = text.indexOf(quote, found + 1)) >= 0) {
    if (++count === occurrence) return {start: offset + found, end: offset + found + quote.length};
  }
  xrEditFail('修改原句不在当前稿的指定位置', 'EDIT_LOCATION');
}

function xrEditRanges(ranges) {
  const positions = ranges.slice().sort(function (a, b) { return b.start - a.start; });
  positions.forEach(function (range, index) {
    if (index && range.end > positions[index - 1].start) xrEditFail('修改区间重叠，整阶段未应用', 'EDIT_OVERLAP');
  });
  return positions;
}

function xrEditApply(draft, ranges, spec) {
  const positions = xrEditRanges(ranges);
  let full = draft.full;
  positions.forEach(function (range) {
    full = full.slice(0, range.start) + range.edit.replacement + full.slice(range.end);
  });
  return xrEditParseDraft(full, spec);
}

function xrEditGroupRanges(draft, group, replacements) {
  return group.sources.map((source, index) => ({
    ...xrEditLocate(draft, source.target, source.index, source.quote, source.occurrence),
    edit: {replacement: replacements[index]}
  }));
}

function xrEditParseProposals(value, draft, spec) {
  const data = xrEditJson(value, ['version', 'draftId', 'groups', 'reason'], '候选改法');
  if (data.version !== 2 || data.draftId !== draft.draftId) xrEditFail('候选改法绑定的稿件版本不一致', 'EDIT_VERSION');
  if (!Array.isArray(data.groups)) xrEditFail('候选问题组列表无效');
  xrEditString(data.reason, '候选说明');
  const ranges = [], groups = data.groups.map((group, index) => {
    xrEditObject(group, ['problem', 'sources', 'candidates'], '问题组');
    xrEditString(group.problem, '具体问题');
    if (!Array.isArray(group.sources) || !group.sources.length) xrEditFail('问题组必须包含原文位置');
    const sources = group.sources.map(source => {
      xrEditObject(source, ['target', 'index', 'quote', 'occurrence'], '原文位置');
      ranges.push(xrEditLocate(draft, source.target, source.index, source.quote, source.occurrence));
      return {target: source.target, index: source.index, quote: source.quote, occurrence: source.occurrence};
    });
    if (!Array.isArray(group.candidates) || ![1, 3].includes(group.candidates.length))
      xrEditFail('每组须提供三个方案；纯删除仅提供一个删除方案');
    const candidates = group.candidates.map(candidate => {
      xrEditObject(candidate, ['replacements'], '整组方案');
      if (!Array.isArray(candidate.replacements) || candidate.replacements.length !== sources.length ||
          candidate.replacements.some(text => typeof text !== 'string')) xrEditFail('方案须逐一提供所有原文片段的替换文字，空串表示删除');
      if (candidate.replacements.every((text, i) => text === sources[i].quote)) xrEditFail('整组方案不能全部保留原文');
      return {replacements: candidate.replacements.slice()};
    });
    if (new Set(candidates.map(candidate => JSON.stringify(candidate.replacements))).size !== candidates.length)
      xrEditFail('整组方案的替换文字不得完全相同');
    if (candidates.length === 1 && candidates[0].replacements.some(text => text !== '')) xrEditFail('单一方案仅用于全组删除');
    const pool = [{replacements: sources.map(source => source.quote)}, ...candidates]
      .map((candidate, choice) => ({choice, replacements: candidate.replacements})), options = [];
    while (pool.length) options.push(pool.splice(Math.floor(Math.random() * pool.length), 1)[0]);
    return {id: index + 1, problem: group.problem, sources, options};
  });
  xrEditRanges(ranges);
  groups.forEach(group => {
    group.options.forEach(option => {
      if (option.choice !== 0) xrEditApply(draft, xrEditGroupRanges(draft, group, option.replacements), spec);
    });
  });
  return groups;
}

function xrEditParseSelection(value, draft, groups, spec) {
  const data = xrEditJson(value, ['version', 'draftId', 'choices', 'reason'], '改法比较');
  if (data.version !== 2 || data.draftId !== draft.draftId) xrEditFail('改法比较绑定的稿件版本不一致', 'EDIT_VERSION');
  xrEditString(data.reason, '比较结论');
  if (!Array.isArray(data.choices) || data.choices.length !== groups.length) xrEditFail('比较结果必须逐组选择，不能遗漏');
  const seen = new Set(), ranges = [];
  data.choices.forEach(selection => {
    xrEditObject(selection, ['group', 'choice', 'reason'], '逐组选择');
    const group = groups[selection.group - 1];
    const option = group && group.options.find(option => option.choice === selection.choice);
    if (!Number.isSafeInteger(selection.group) || !group || seen.has(selection.group) ||
        !Number.isSafeInteger(selection.choice) || !option) xrEditFail('比较结果的问题组或方案编号无效或重复');
    xrEditString(selection.reason, '逐组选择原因');
    seen.add(selection.group);
    if (selection.choice === 0) return;
    ranges.push(...xrEditGroupRanges(draft, group, option.replacements));
  });
  return {draft: ranges.length ? xrEditApply(draft, ranges, spec) : draft, count: ranges.length, reason: data.reason};
}

function xrEditTextSources(value) {
  if (typeof value === 'string' || typeof value === 'boolean' || typeof value === 'number' && Number.isFinite(value)) return [value];
  if (!value || typeof value !== 'object') return [];
  return Object.values(value).flatMap(xrEditTextSources);
}

function xrEditParseCast(value, draft) {
  const data = xrEditJson(value, ['version', 'draftId', 'characters'], '互动人物', 'CAST_FORMAT');
  if (data.version !== 1 || data.draftId !== draft.draftId || !Array.isArray(data.characters))
    xrEditFail('互动人物名单的版本或格式不正确', 'CAST_FORMAT');
  const labels = new Set();
  return data.characters.map(person => {
    xrEditObject(person, ['label', 'name', 'evidence'], '人物', 'CAST_FORMAT');

function xrEditParseCharacterBehavior(value, draft, context, characters, database) {
  const code = 'ANALYSIS_FORMAT';
  const data = xrEditJson(value, ['version', 'draftId', 'findings'], '角色行为分析', code);
  if (data.version !== 1 || data.draftId !== draft.draftId || !Array.isArray(data.findings))
    xrEditFail('角色行为分析的版本或格式不正确', code);

    ['character', 'problem', 'suggestion'].forEach(function (key) { xrEditString(finding[key], '人物分析' + key, code); });

  const workflowRules = (input.ruleBundle || {}).workflowRules || {};
  function ruleText(key) {

  }

    {key: 'edit.content', text: '对照本轮输入、历史事实和已有规则，只修复具体遗漏、事实冲突、时间位置矛盾和因果断裂；不为换说法改动有效内容。'},

' + banned});

  if (plan.humanizer) finishRules.push({key: 'edit.humanizer', text: ruleText('NEO_HUMANIZER_FULL')});
  let current, characters = [], database = [], findings = [];
  const log = (event, detail) => { if (input.log) input.log(event, detail); };
  function addEvidenceInstructions(data) {
    if (database.length) Object.assign(data, {providedMaterials: database,

  }

    if (input.signal?.aborted) xrEditFail('任务已取消', 'CANCELLED');

    const value = await callModel({phase, label, messages});

    return value;
  }
  const contractRuleTexts = new Set(contract.rules.map(rule => rule.text.trim()));
  function common(rules) {
    const supplementaryRules = rules.filter(rule => !contractRuleTexts.has(String(rule.text).trim()));
    return {editorContract: contract, supplementaryRules, draftId: current.draftId, text: current.body,
      actions: current.actions.map((text, index) => ({index: index + 1, text})), deliveryConstraints: spec};

    if (characters.length) {

        behaviorData), current, nativeContext, characters, database);

    {enabled: plan.body, phase: 'content', key: 'STAGE_CONTENT_EDIT', label: '正文局部重写', rules: contentRules},
    {enabled: plan.finish, phase: 'finish', key: 'STAGE_FINISH_EDIT', label: '润色修改', rules: finishRules}

  }

}

  const data = {choices: [{index: 0, message: {role: 'assistant', content: text}, finish_reason: 'stop'}]};
  if (!stream) return new host.Response(JSON.stringify(data), {status: 200, headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'}});
  const event = source === 'claude' ? {type: 'content_block_delta', index: 0, delta: {type: 'text_delta', text: text}} :
    source === 'makersuite' || source === 'vertexai' ? {candidates: [{content: {parts: [{text: text}]}}]} :
    source === 'cohere' ? {type: 'content-delta', delta: {message: {content: {text: text}}}} :
    {choices: [{index: 0, delta: {role: 'assistant', content: text}, finish_reason: 'stop'}]};
  return new host.Response('data: ' + JSON.stringify(event) + '

data: [DONE]

',
    {status: 200, headers: {'Content-Type': 'text/event-stream'}});
}

function xrMultiIsNativeGeneration(type, params, dryRun) {
  return !dryRun && !(params && params.automatic_trigger) && !stableQuietLike(type, params, dryRun) && ['normal', 'regenerate', 'reroll', 'swipe'].indexOf(String(type)) >= 0;
}

async function connectNativeRequest(run, request) {
  const host = runtimeResolveHostWindow(), context = getSTContextSafe(), bus = policyResolveEventBus();
  if (!context || !bus || !['CHAT_COMPLETION_SETTINGS_READY', 'MESSAGE_RECEIVED', 'GENERATION_ENDED'].every(name => bus.types[name]))
    throw xrMultiSafeError('酒馆缺少原生请求或完成事件', 'SETUP_ERROR');
  Object.assign(run, {marker: 'XR_NATIVE_' + Date.now() + '_' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2),
    releasedText: '', received: false});
  run.log('自动接管', (run.type === 'normal' ? '新用户回合已登记' : '已有用户回合重生成已登记') + '；来源=CHAT_COMPLETION_SETTINGS_READY；本轮USER=' + run.turn.index);
  const next = host.fetch, internal = Symbol.for('acu.internal-generation-fetch');
  const unsupported = context.mainApi !== 'openai' || context.groupId != null;
  runController.assertCurrent(run);
  const marker = {role: 'system', content: run.marker};
  RE_TRANSPORT_MARKERS.add(marker);
  request.event.messages.push(marker);
  async function generateResponse(init) {
    const signal = init.signal;
    const nativeAbort = () => {
      if (run === GENERATION) runController.cancel('酒馆取消了原生请求');
    };
    if (signal) {
      signal.addEventListener('abort', nativeAbort, {once: true});
      run.resources.push(() => signal.removeEventListener('abort', nativeAbort));
      if (signal.aborted) nativeAbort();
    }
    try {
      const payload = JSON.parse(init.body), format = payload.response_format;
      if (unsupported || Number(payload.n || 1) !== 1 ||
          Array.isArray(payload.tools) && payload.tools.length || payload.json_schema || payload.request_images || format && format.type !== 'text')
        throw xrMultiSafeError('不支持酒馆一次生成多份回复、工具调用、结构化输出或图片回复', 'UNSUPPORTED_REQUEST');
      if (!Array.isArray(payload.messages) || !payload.messages.length) throw xrMultiSafeError('原生请求没有有效上下文', 'INVALID_RESPONSE');
      run.callCount = 0;
      run.stageCount = 0;
      const nativeContext = fewShotFreeze(payload.messages.filter(message => !(message.role === 'system' && message.content === run.marker)));
      const databaseSnapshot = fewShotFreeze(xrMultiCaptureDatabase(run.plan));
      runController.assertCurrent(run);
      async function requestStage(task) {
        runController.assertCurrent(run);
        if (run.stageCount >= run.plan.callCount) throw xrMultiSafeError('已达到本轮阶段上限；未交付正文', 'CALL_BUDGET');
        run.stageCount++;
        run.log('阶段载荷', task.phase + '；输入内容字符数=' + task.messages.reduce((total, message) => total + transportTextContent(message.content).length, 0));
        const outgoing = {...payload, messages: task.messages, stream: false};
        if (task.phase !== 'draft') {
          Object.assign(outgoing, {type: 'quiet', n: 1, include_reasoning: false, enable_web_search: false, request_images: false});
          for (const key of ['stop', 'tools', 'tool_choice', 'json_schema', 'response_format', 'logit_bias', 'logprobs', 'top_logprobs']) delete outgoing[key];
        }
        const body = JSON.stringify(outgoing), retries = run.config.retryEnabled === 1 ? run.config.retryCount : 0;
        const budget = outgoing.max_completion_tokens == null ? outgoing.max_tokens : outgoing.max_completion_tokens;
        run.log('请求限制', task.label + '；输出token上限=' + (budget != null && Number.isFinite(Number(budget)) ? Number(budget) : '未提供') +
          '；停止词数量=' + (Array.isArray(outgoing.stop) ? outgoing.stop.length : typeof outgoing.stop === 'string' && outgoing.stop ? 1 : 0) +
          '；请求类型=' + (/^[A-Za-z_]{1,32}$/.test(String(outgoing.type || '')) ? outgoing.type : '未提供') + '；流式=0');
        for (let attempt = 0; ; attempt++) {
          runController.assertCurrent(run);
          const label = task.label + (attempt ? '（重试 ' + attempt + '/' + retries + '）' : '');
          run.report({phase: task.phase, label, callCount: ++run.callCount});
          runController.arm(run, label);
          let response;
          try {
            try {
              response = await xrMultiAwait(run.controller.signal, next.call(host, '/api/backends/chat-completions/generate',
                {...init, body, signal: run.controller.signal, [internal]: true}));
            } catch (cause) {
              if (run.controller.signal.aborted || cause?.xrSafe || cause?.name === 'AbortError') throw cause;
              const error = xrMultiApiError({error: {message: cause?.message, code: cause?.code || cause?.cause?.code, type: cause?.name}});
              error.name = xrMultiErrorType(cause);
              error.retryable = cause?.name === 'TypeError' || ['ECONNRESET', 'ETIMEDOUT', 'EPIPE', 'EAI_AGAIN', 'ENETUNREACH', 'ECONNREFUSED']
                .includes(cause?.code || cause?.cause?.code);
              throw error;
            }
            run.log('HTTP', task.label + '；状态=' + response.status);
            let data, diagnostic;
            try { diagnostic = response.clone(); } catch (_) {}
            try { data = await xrMultiAwait(run.controller.signal, response.json()); }
            catch (error) {
              if (error && error.xrSafe) throw error;
              const reader = diagnostic || (!response.bodyUsed ? response : null);
              const raw = reader && typeof reader.text === 'function' ? await xrMultiAwait(run.controller.signal, reader.text()).catch(() => '') : '';
              data = {error: true, message: '接口未返回有效JSON响应', response: raw};
            }
            runController.assertCurrent(run);
            if (!response.ok) {
              const error = xrMultiApiError(data, response.status);
              run.log('接口错误', error.message); throw error;
            }
            const result = xrMultiResponseText(data, run.log, response.status);
            run.lastResponse = {label: task.label, text: result};
            run.log('响应完成', task.label + '；返回字符数=' + result.length);
            return result;
          } catch (error) {
            if (typeof error?.modelText === 'string') run.lastResponse = {label: task.label, text: error.modelText};
            if (run.controller.signal.aborted || !error?.retryable || attempt >= retries) throw error;
            clearTimeout(run.timer);
            const retryAfter = error.httpStatus === 429 || error.businessStatuses?.includes(429) ? response?.headers?.get('Retry-After') : null;
            const requestedDelay = retryAfter && (/^\d+(?:\.\d+)?$/.test(retryAfter.trim())
              ? Number(retryAfter) * 1000 : Date.parse(retryAfter) - Date.now());
            const waitMs = retryAfter && Number.isFinite(requestedDelay) ? Math.min(2147483647, Math.max(0, requestedDelay)) : 2000;
            run.log('失败重试', task.label + '；重试=' + (attempt + 1) + '/' + retries + '；等待=' + (waitMs / 1000).toFixed(2) + '秒；原因=' + error.message);
            run.report({label: task.label + '；等待重试 ' + (attempt + 1) + '/' + retries});
            await xrMultiAwait(run.controller.signal, new Promise(resolve => { run.timer = setTimeout(resolve, waitMs); }));
          } finally { clearTimeout(run.timer); }
        }
      }
      const text = await xrGenerateOptimizedDraft({
        context: nativeContext, databaseSnapshot,
        ownMessages: request.ownMessages,
        snapshot: request.snapshot, ruleBundle: request.ruleBundle, config: run.config, plan: run.plan,
        signal: run.controller.signal, log: run.log,
        onSnapshot: snapshot => { run.acceptedDraft = snapshot; }
      }, requestStage);
      runController.assertCurrent(run);
      if (typeof text !== 'string' || !text.trim()) throw xrMultiSafeError('最终正文为空；未交付正文', 'INVALID_RESPONSE');
      run.releasedText = text;
      run.report({phase: 'deliver', label: '等待酒馆显示正文'}); runController.arm(run, '酒馆接收正文');
      run.log('交付状态', '阶段处理与本地校验完成；只释放一次最终回复');
      return xrMultiFinalResponse(host, payload.chat_completion_source, !!payload.stream, text);
    } catch (error) { runController.settle(run, error); throw error; }
  }
  const wrapper = function (url, init) {
    if (init && init[internal] || typeof (init && init.body) !== 'string' || !init.body.includes(run.marker)) return next.call(this || host, url, init);
    if (run.completed || run.controller.signal.aborted) return Promise.reject(xrMultiSafeError(run.reason || '本轮任务已结束', run.errorCode || 'CANCELLED'));
    const endpoint = new host.URL(typeof url === 'object' && url.url ? url.url : String(url), host.location.href);
    if (endpoint.origin !== host.location.origin || endpoint.pathname !== '/api/backends/chat-completions/generate' || String(init.method || 'GET').toUpperCase() !== 'POST')
      return next.call(this || host, url, init);
    try { runController.claim(run); }
    catch (error) { runController.settle(run, error); return Promise.reject(error); }
    return generateResponse(init);
  };
  host.fetch = wrapper;
  run.resources.push(() => { if (host.fetch === wrapper) host.fetch = next; });
  runController.arm(run, '原生前处理与正文请求');
  return run.done;
}

function stopNativeGeneration(log) {
  const context = getSTContextSafe(), host = runtimeResolveHostWindow();
  const failed = error => log('原生停止', '停止接口失败；类型=' + xrMultiErrorType(error));
  try {
    if (typeof context?.stopGeneration === 'function') Promise.resolve(context.stopGeneration()).catch(failed);
    else {
      const stop = runtimeHostDocument().getElementById('mes_stop');
      if (stop && host.getComputedStyle(stop).display !== 'none') stop.click();
    }
  } catch (error) { failed(error); }
}

/* ===== pipeline: generation ===== */
function createRunController() {
  let lastRun = null, sequence = 0;
  const listeners = new Set();
  const active = () => GENERATION?.optimizing ? GENERATION : null;

  async function prepare(type, params, dryRun) {
    if (stableQuietLike(type, params, dryRun)) return;
    const run = GENERATION || begin(type, params, dryRun);
    if (!run || run.inputPlan || run.request || run.type === 'impersonate') return;
    try {
      const plan = isoGenerationPlan(run.type, run.params, run.dryRun, run.startedUser, run.startSettings, run.startInput);
      await repairRunTransaction(async scope => {
        if (run !== GENERATION || run.controller.signal.aborted) return;
        repairAssertCurrentChat(scope.chat);
        isoCommitGeneration(plan);
        run.inputPlan = plan;
      });
    } catch (error) { reFailRequest(error, run); }
  }

  async function handle(name, value, params, dryRun) {
    if (standaloneLifecycle.disposed) return;
    const run = GENERATION;
    try {
      if (name === 'GENERATION_STARTED') return begin(value, params, dryRun);
      if (name === 'GENERATION_AFTER_COMMANDS') return prepare(value, params, dryRun);
      if (name === 'CHAT_CHANGED') {
        xrMultiResetMaster();
        isoLoadCurrentChat();
        if (!cancel('聊天已切换', false, 'CHAT_CHANGED')) publish();
        return;
      }
      if (!run) return;
      if (name === 'GENERATE_AFTER_DATA') {
        if (!params && run.inputPlan && !run.nativePrompt && !run.request && !run.completed && !run.controller.signal.aborted &&
            wbSameChat(run.chat, repairChatIdentity()) && Array.isArray(value?.prompt)) run.nativePrompt = value.prompt;
      } else if (name === 'js_generation_requested') {
        if (typeof value === 'string') run.helperRuns.add(value);
      } else if (name === 'CHAT_COMPLETION_SETTINGS_READY') {
        const request = await deliverPrompt(value);
        if (request && run === GENERATION) void start(run, request);
      } else if (name === 'MESSAGE_RECEIVED') return await received(value);
      else if (name === 'GENERATION_ENDED' || name === 'GENERATION_STOPPED') await ended(name, value);
      else if (run.optimizing && name === 'MESSAGE_EDITED') {
        const index = Number(value?.index ?? value?.message_id ?? value?.messageId ?? value);
        const user = currentBranchMessages()[run.turn?.index];
        if (index === run.turn?.index || run.turn?.userId && messageIdentity(user) !== run.turn.userId ||
            run.turn && messageText(user) !== run.turn.userText)
          throw xrMultiSafeError('本轮用户消息已修改', 'CHAT_EDITED');
        assertCurrent(run);
      } else if (run.optimizing && ['MESSAGE_UPDATED', 'MESSAGE_DELETED', 'MESSAGE_SWIPED'].includes(name)) assertCurrent(run);
    } catch (error) {
      if (!run || run !== GENERATION) return;
      if (run.optimizing) cancel(error.message, true, error.code);
      else reFailRequest(error, run);
    }
  }

  function assertCurrent(run) {
    if (run !== GENERATION || standaloneLifecycle.disposed || run.controller.signal.aborted)
      throw xrMultiSafeError(run.reason || '任务已停止', run.errorCode || 'CANCELLED');
    const identity = repairChatIdentity(), expected = run.chat;
    if (expected.chatId !== identity.chatId || expected.characterId !== identity.characterId || expected.groupId !== identity.groupId)
      throw xrMultiSafeError('聊天已切换', 'CHAT_CHANGED');
    if (expected.metadata !== identity.metadata) {
      run.log('聊天身份', '稳定身份未变；接受元数据对象更新');
      expected.metadata = identity.metadata;
    }
    const chat = currentBranchMessages(), turn = run.turn, user = chat[turn.index];
    if (!turn.prefix.every((message, index) => {
      const current = chat[index];
      return current && message.is_user === current.is_user && message.name === current.name && message.text === messageText(current);
    })) throw xrMultiSafeError('聊天分支已变化', 'CHAT_EDITED');
    if (!user) throw xrMultiSafeError('本轮用户消息已移除', 'CHAT_EDITED');
    if (!user.is_user || chat.slice(turn.index + 1).some(message => message?.is_user))
      throw xrMultiSafeError('本轮用户消息范围已变化', 'CHAT_EDITED');
    if (run.claimed && user.name !== turn.name) throw xrMultiSafeError('本轮用户身份已变化', 'CHAT_EDITED');
    return user;
  }

  function claim(run) {
    if (run.claimed) throw xrMultiSafeError('本轮正文请求被重复发送', 'SETUP_ERROR');
    run.turn.name = assertCurrent(run).name;
    run.claimed = true;
    run.log('请求冻结', '已冻结前处理后的本轮用户消息与原生上下文');
  }

  function status() {
    const run = active(), record = run || lastRun;
    return record ? {phase: record.phase, label: record.label, error: record.error || '', errorCode: record.errorCode || '',
      callCount: record.callCount, finalChars: record.finalChars, busy: !!run && !run.completed,
      cancelling: !!run && run.controller.signal.aborted && !run.completed}
      : {phase: 'idle', label: '就绪', error: '', errorCode: '', callCount: 0, finalChars: 0, busy: false, cancelling: false};
  }

  function log(record, event, detail) {
    if (!record) return;
    record.entries.push('[' + new Date().toISOString() + ' +' + ((Date.now() - record.startedAt) / 1000).toFixed(2) + 's] ' + event + ' | ' + detail);
    if (record.entries.length > 100) record.entries.shift();
  }

  function publish() {
    const value = status();
    for (const listener of listeners) {
      try { listener(value); } catch (error) { console.warn('[剑仙RE] 界面刷新失败', error); }
    }
  }

  function report(run, patch) {
    Object.assign(run, patch);
    if (patch.phase) {
      run.log('阶段', run.label + '；模型调用 ' + run.callCount);
      if (run.optimizing) notify(run.label);
    }
    publish();
  }

  function settle(run, error, text = '') {
    if (!run || run.completed) return;
    run.completed = true;
    if (error) run.controller.abort();
    clearTimeout(run.timer);
    for (const dispose of run.resources.splice(0).reverse()) {
      try { dispose(); } catch (cause) { run.log('清理警告', xrMultiErrorType(cause)); }
    }
    run.continuation = null;
    if (run.optimizing) {
      if (error) {
        const code = run.errorCode || error.code || 'API_ERROR';
        const message = run.reason || String(error.message || error);
        run.log('错误 ' + code, '失败阶段=' + run.label + '；原因=' + message);
        if (run.acceptedDraft) run.log('最近已接受稿', run.acceptedDraft.text);
        if (run.lastResponse) run.log('最近模型回复', run.lastResponse.label + '
' + run.lastResponse.text);
        Object.assign(run, {phase: code === 'CANCELLED' ? 'cancelled' : 'error', label: '生成未完成', error: message, errorCode: code});
      } else Object.assign(run, {phase: 'done', label: '最终回复已显示在聊天中', finalChars: text.length});
      run.lastResponse = null;
      lastRun = {phase: run.phase, label: run.label, error: run.error, errorCode: run.errorCode,
        callCount: run.callCount, finalChars: run.finalChars, sequence: run.sequence,
        startedAt: run.startedAt, entries: run.entries};
    }
    if (GENERATION === run) GENERATION = null;
    (error ? run.reject : run.resolve)(error || text);
    publish();
  }

  function cancel(reason, stopNative = true, code = 'CANCELLED') {
    const run = GENERATION;
    if (!run || run.completed) return false;
    run.reason = reason || '用户取消本次运行';
    run.errorCode = code;
    settle(run, xrMultiSafeError(run.reason, code));
    if (stopNative) stopNativeGeneration(run.log);
    return true;
  }

  function begin(type, params, dryRun) {
    if (stableQuietLike(type, params, dryRun)) return;
    const kind = String(type || 'normal').toLowerCase();
    if (!['normal', 'regenerate', 'reroll', 'swipe', 'continue', 'impersonate'].includes(kind)) return;
    cancel('另一轮生成已开始', false);
    lifecycleRefreshPreferencesFromStorage();
    const config = fewShotFreeze(isoClone(xrMultiReadConfig()));
    const run = {
      id: reRequestId(params), type: kind, params: params || {}, dryRun: !!dryRun,
      chat: repairChatIdentity(), startedUser: ['regenerate', 'reroll', 'swipe', 'continue'].includes(kind)
        ? null : lifecycleCurrentUserIdentity(), config, plan: xrMultiPlan(config),
      startSettings: fewShotFreeze(cloneStateSnapshot()), startInput: isoCurrentInputText(),
      styleDrafts: fewShotFreeze(isoClone(USER_SURFACE_STYLE_RUNTIME.drafts)),
      controller: new AbortController(), helperRuns: new Set(),
      phase: 'preparing', label: '准备本轮生成', completed: false,
      entries: [], resources: [], stageCount: 0, callCount: 0, finalChars: 0, startedAt: Date.now()
    };
    run.done = new Promise((resolve, reject) => { run.resolve = resolve; run.reject = reject; });
    run.done.catch(() => {});
    run.log = (event, detail) => log(run, event, detail);
    run.report = patch => report(run, patch);
    GENERATION = run;
    return run;
  }

  async function start(run, request) {
    if (run !== GENERATION || run.optimizing || !run.plan.active || !xrMultiIsNativeGeneration(run.type, run.params, run.dryRun)) return;
    try {
      const {index} = lifecycleCurrentUserIdentity();
      if (index < 0) throw xrMultiSafeError('没有本轮用户消息', 'SETUP_ERROR');
      const user = currentBranchMessages()[index];
      run.turn = {index, name: null, userId: messageIdentity(user), userText: messageText(user), prefix: currentBranchMessages().slice(0, index)
        .map(message => ({name: message.name, is_user: message.is_user, text: messageText(message)}))};
      Object.assign(run, {optimizing: true, sequence: ++sequence, request});
      run.report({phase: 'native', label: '等待正文请求'});
      run.log('运行设置', '正文局部重写=' + Number(run.plan.body) + '；润色修改=' + Number(run.plan.finish) +
        '；角色行为分析=' + Number(run.plan.behavior) + '；Humanizer=' + Number(run.plan.humanizer) +
        '；计划调用=' + run.plan.callCount + '；阶段超时=' + run.config.timeoutSeconds + '秒；失败重试=' + Number(run.config.retryEnabled === 1) +
        '；每阶段重试次数=' + (run.config.retryEnabled === 1 ? run.config.retryCount : 0));
      await connectNativeRequest(run, request);
    } catch (error) { settle(run, error); }
  }

  function arm(run, label) {
    clearTimeout(run.timer);
    run.timer = setTimeout(() => {
      if (run !== GENERATION || run.completed) return;
      cancel(label + '超时；已停止本轮，未释放草稿', true, 'TIMEOUT');
    }, run.config.timeoutSeconds * 1000);
  }

  async function received(index) {
    const run = GENERATION;
    if (!run) return;
    await fewShotCleanContinuation(index);
    if (run !== GENERATION || run.completed || !run.optimizing || !run.releasedText || run.phase !== 'deliver') return;
    const message = currentBranchMessages()[Number(index)];
    if (Number(index) === run.turn.index + 1 && isAssistantMessage(message) && messageText(message).trim()) {
      assertCurrent(run);
      run.received = true;
      if (run.ended) settle(run, null, run.releasedText);
    }
  }

  async function ended(name, value) {
    const run = GENERATION;
    if (!run || run.helperRuns.has(value) || typeof value === 'string' && !/^\d+$/.test(value)) return;
    if (!run.optimizing) {
      if (name === 'GENERATION_ENDED' && run.continuation) await fewShotCleanContinuation(run.continuation.index);
      if (run === GENERATION) settle(run, null);
      return;
    }
    if (name === 'GENERATION_STOPPED' || !run.releasedText)
      return cancel(name === 'GENERATION_STOPPED' ? '酒馆已停止生成' : '酒馆生成结束，但未生成最终正文');
    // 流式酒馆先结束生成再通知收到消息；保留交付超时，等待两项确认。
    run.ended = true;
    if (run.received) settle(run, null, run.releasedText);
  }

  return {
    begin, prepare, handle, assertCurrent, claim, start, settle, cancel, arm, received, ended, status, getSession: active,
    getConfig: xrMultiReadConfig, settingsError: () => settingsStore.error(),
    updateConfig(patch) { xrMultiSaveConfig({...xrMultiReadConfig(), ...patch}); publish(); return true; },
    refreshConfig: publish,
    subscribe(listener) { listeners.add(listener); return () => listeners.delete(listener); },
    uiError(code, message) { log(active() || lastRun, '界面错误 ' + code, message); publish(); },
    diagnostics() {
      const run = active() || lastRun;
      return '剑仙RE-Neo · 多轮优化生成诊断日志
' + (run
        ? '运行编号：' + run.sequence + '
状态：' + run.label + '
模型调用：' + run.callCount +
          ' 次；最终回复：' + run.finalChars + ' 字符
失败日志包含最近模型回复，不含完整请求、密钥。

' + run.entries.join('
')
        : '尚无运行记录。');
    }
  };
}

    if (standaloneLifecycle.disposed) return;
    isoEnsureCurrentChat();
    return openUi();

function uiBindPreferenceControls() {
  const root = xrRoot();
  if (!root || root.xrFieldsBound) return;
  root.xrFieldsBound = true; root.xrComposing = new WeakSet();

    const field = node && root.xrFieldNodeMap.get(node);
    if (!field) return;
    if (!root.contains(node) || node.disabled || !xrFieldEnabled(field)) return;
    if (event.type === 'compositionstart') { root.xrComposing.add(node); return; }

    if (node.tagName === 'BUTTON' ? event.type !== 'click' : event.type === 'click') return;

    if (value === undefined) return;

    try { published = xrWriteField(field, node, value, event) === true; }
    catch (error) {
      if (field.scope === 'workflow') {
        runController.uiError('SETTINGS_SAVE_FAILED', error.message || runController.settingsError());
        published = true;
      }
      notifyError(error.message || String(error));
    }

function xrFieldDefinitions() {

    {attribute: 'data-custom-length', key: 'customLengthEnabled', type: 'boolean'},
    {attribute: 'data-nsfw-style-toggle', key: 'nsfwStyleEnabled', type: 'boolean', valueAttribute: 'data-value'},
    {attribute: 'data-suggest-enabled', key: 'suggestedActionsEnabled', type: 'boolean'},
    {attribute: 'data-chat-responder-name', key: 'chatResponderName', scope: 'turn'},
    {attribute: 'data-custom-length-chars', key: 'customLengthChars', type: 'digits'},
    {attribute: 'data-nsfw-style-text', key: 'nsfwStyleText'},
    {attribute: 'data-style-custom-text', key: 'customText', scope: 'style'},
    {attribute: 'data-stable-pov-character', key: 'povCharacter'},
    {attribute: 'data-stable-pov', key: 'povMode'},
    {attribute: 'data-suggest-count', key: 'suggestedActionsCount', type: 'number', min: 1,

    {attribute: 'data-userSurface-internal-style-custom', scope: 'overlay'},
    {attribute: 'data-slot', scope: 'draft'}

  for (const [attribute, profile] of Object.entries(LIMIT_SWITCHES)) {
    fields.push({attribute, key: profile.stateKey, type: 'boolean', content: '.xr-limit-children[data-limit-parent="' + profile.stateKey + '"]'});
    for (const block of profile.blocks) {
      const child = block[3];

    }
  }
  for (const [key, profile] of Object.entries(CHARACTER_DYNAMICS_PROFILES)) {
    fields.push({attribute: 'data-characterDynamics-toggle', match: key, key: profile.stateKey,

  for (const [key, field] of Object.entries(XR_WORKFLOW_FIELDS)) {

function xrEnsureFieldNodes(root) {

function xrFieldEventNode(root, target) {

function xrReadField(field, node, workflow) {
  if (field.scope === 'workflow') return (workflow || runController.getConfig())[field.key];
  if (field.scope === 'style') return currentStyleConfig()[field.key];
  if (field.scope === 'turn') return currentSettings()[field.key];
  if (field.scope === 'overlay') return promptInternalStyleRaw();
  if (field.scope === 'draft') return currentSettings().drafts[node.getAttribute('data-field-mode')][node.getAttribute('data-slot')];
  return state[field.key];
}

function xrParseField(field, node, event) {
  const raw = node.tagName === 'BUTTON' ? node.getAttribute(field.valueAttribute || field.attribute) : node.value;
  if (field.type === 'boolean') return raw === 'ON';
  if (field.type === 'switch') return Number(node.value);
  if (field.type === 'digits') {
    const value = raw.replace(/[^\d]/g, '');
    if (node.value !== value) node.value = value;
    return value;
  }
  if (field.type !== 'number') return raw;
  const value = Number(raw), valid = !!raw.trim() && Number.isSafeInteger(value) && value >= field.min && value <= field.max;
  node.setCustomValidity(valid ? '' : xrHelpText(field.invalidHelp || 'branch.readField.7792.217'));
  node.setAttribute('aria-invalid', String(!valid));
  if (valid) return value;
  if (event.type === 'focusout' || event.type === 'change') {
    node.value = String(xrReadField(field, node)); node.setCustomValidity(''); node.setAttribute('aria-invalid', 'false');
    if (field.restoreHelp) notify(xrHelpText(field.restoreHelp, {'恢复后的秒数': node.value}));
  }
}

function xrWriteField(field, node, value, event) {
  if (xrReadField(field, node) === value && !(field.scope === 'workflow' && runController.settingsError())) return true;
  if (field.scope === 'workflow') {
    runController.updateConfig({[field.key]: value});
    return true;
  } else if (field.scope === 'draft') {
    const mode = node.getAttribute('data-field-mode'), slot = node.getAttribute('data-slot');
    currentTurn().drafts[mode][slot] = value; isoPersistLive(event.type === 'change');
    xrUpdateComputed('fields'); return true;
  } else if (field.scope === 'turn') {
    currentTurn()[field.key] = value; isoPersistLive(false);
    xrUpdateComputed('fields'); return true;
  } else if (field.scope === 'overlay') {
    const key = userSurfaceInternalStyleKey();
    if (key) { USER_SURFACE_STYLE_RUNTIME.drafts[key] = value; markRuntimeDirty(); }
    xrRenderStyles(); return true;
  } else {
    const target = field.scope === 'style' ? currentStyleConfig() : state;
    target[field.key] = value; saveState();
    if (field.profile) notify(field.profile.title + '：' + (value ? '已开启' : '已关闭') + '｜当前组合 ' + (characterDynamicsActiveModules().join(' + ') || '全部关闭'));
    if (node.tagName !== 'BUTTON') {
      if (field.scope === 'style') xrRenderStyles();
      else if (field.key === 'suggestedActionsCount') xrRenderSuggestions();
      else if (field.key === 'povMode') render('fields');
      else xrUpdateComputed('fields');

    }
  }
}

function xrProjectFields(scope) {
  const root = xrRoot();
  if (!root) return;
  xrEnsureFieldNodes(root);
  const context = String(isoGetRecord(false)?.chatInstanceId || ''), changedChat = root.xrFieldContext !== context;
  const workflow = runController.getConfig();
  if (!scope) {
    root.xrFieldContext = context;
    if (changedChat) root.xrComposing = new WeakSet();
  }
  for (const entry of root.xrFieldNodes) {
    const field = entry.field;
    if (scope && field.scope !== scope) continue;
    const enabled = xrFieldEnabled(field, workflow);
    const nodes = entry.nodes;
    for (const node of nodes) {
      if (field.scope === 'workflow' || field.parent) xrSetDisabled(node, !enabled);
      const value = xrReadField(field, node, workflow);
      if (node.tagName === 'BUTTON') {
        const selected = xrParseField(field, node, {type: 'projection'}) === value;
        node.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(selected));
        if (field.key === 'mode') { node.setAttribute('aria-selected', String(selected)); node.tabIndex = selected ? 0 : -1; }
      } else if (changedChat || !(root.xrComposing && root.xrComposing.has(node)) &&
          !(node === root.ownerDocument.activeElement && node.type === 'number')) {
        const text = value == null ? '' : String(value);
        if (node.value !== text) node.value = text;
      }
    }
    if (entry.content) xrSetVisible(entry.content, enabled && !!xrReadField(field, nodes[0], workflow), nodes[0]);
  }
}

    const theme = xrTheme();
    if (root.getAttribute('data-theme') !== theme) root.setAttribute('data-theme', theme);
    // Recompute the module palette only when its theme or background changes.
    xrApplyChromaPalette(root);
    const btn = xrElement('theme-toggle');
    if (btn.xrTheme === theme) return;
    const labels = { dark: '深色', light: '浅色', tavern: '酒馆原生' };
    const next = xrNextTheme();
    btn.classList.remove('icon-button'); btn.classList.add('button', 'xr-theme-button');
    btn.title = '当前配色：' + labels[theme] + '；点击切换到' + labels[next];
    btn.setAttribute('aria-label', btn.title);
    btn.innerHTML = xrIcon(theme === 'light' ? 'sun' : theme === 'tavern' ? 'leaf' : 'moon', true) + '<span>' + labels[theme] + '</span>';
    btn.xrTheme = theme;
  }

function render(region = 'all') {
  const root = xrRoot();
  if (!root || root.ownerDocument.hidden) return;
  if (region === 'suggestions') { xrRenderSuggestions(); return; }
  if (region === 'fields') {
    xrRenderFields(); xrProjectFields(); xrUpdateComputed('fields');
    return;
  }
  if (region === 'workflow') {
    if (xrMultiUi) xrMultiUi.render();
    xrProjectFields('workflow'); xrUpdateComputed('workflow'); setActionBusy(UI_ACTIONS_UI_BUSY);
    return;
  }
  const availability = worldbookSourceState().status === 'READY' ? wbRuleAvailabilityStatus() : null;
  if (region === 'status') {
    xrRenderStatus(availability); xrRenderSourceDialog(availability); xrUpdateComputed('status', availability);
    return;
  }
  xrApplyTheme();
  xrRenderFields(); xrRenderStyles(); xrRenderSuggestions(); xrRenderStatus(availability); xrRenderSourceDialog(availability);
  if (xrMultiUi) xrMultiUi.render();
  xrProjectFields(); xrUpdateComputed('all', availability); xrBind();
  xrSetText('mode-rule', xrModeSummary(state.mode));
  setActionBusy(UI_ACTIONS_UI_BUSY);
}

function xrMountHelpText(root) {
  for (const node of root.querySelectorAll('[data-help-text]')) {
    node.textContent = xrHelpText(node.getAttribute('data-help-text'));

  for (const node of root.querySelectorAll('[data-help-markup]')) {

}

async function standaloneInvokeAction(action, options) {
    if (standaloneLifecycle.disposed) return {ok: false, error: 'SCRIPT_DISPOSED'};
    if (standaloneAction) return {ok: false, error: 'ACTION_BUSY'};
    action = {append: 'write', install: 'install-worldbooks', uninstall: 'uninstall-worldbooks'}[action] || String(action || '');
    const busy = action === 'write' || action === 'sync-runtime';
    standaloneAction = true;
    try {
      if (busy) setActionBusy(true);
      if (action === 'write') {
        try {
          const prepared = prepareWritePayload();
          const didWrite = writeToInput(prepared.text, prepared.snapshot);
          if (didWrite !== false) { notify('已更新输入框中的剑仙内容'); close(); }
          return {ok: didWrite !== false};
        } catch (error) {
          console.error('[剑仙RE] write action failed', error);
          notifyError('写入失败：' + (error && error.message ? error.message : error));
          return {ok: false, error: String(error && error.message ? error.message : error)};
        }
      }
      if (action === 'sync-runtime') return await compileRuntime(options);
      if (action === 'clear-runtime') return await clearRuntimeInjection();
      if (action === 'clear') return clearUnlockedInput();
      if (action === 'restore') return {ok: !!xrInputHistoryRestore(), status: isoStatus()};
      if (action === 'close') { close(); return {ok: true}; }
      if (action === 'install-worldbooks') return await managedWorldbookBundleInstall();
      if (action === 'uninstall-worldbooks') return await managedWorldbookBundleUninstall();
      return {ok: false, error: 'UNKNOWN_UI_ACTION:' + action};
    } finally {
      standaloneAction = null;
      if (busy) setActionBusy(false);
    }
  }

function startRuntime() {
    routerBindCleanup();
    try { lifecycleRefreshPreferencesFromStorage(); } catch (_) {}
    try { if (settingsStore.shouldInitialize()) saveState(); } catch (_) {}
    try {
      isoLoadCurrentChat();
    } catch (error) {
      console.warn('[剑仙RE] 初始聊天状态暂未就绪', error);
    }
    LAUNCHER_BOOT_BOOT.runtimeReady = true;
    let attempts = 0;
    function attempt() {
      if (standaloneLifecycle.disposed) return;
      const ready = register();
      attempts++;
      // Keep the initial metadata recovery window; stop retrying after 30 seconds.
      if (attempts < 9 || !ready && attempts < 61) setTimeout(attempt, 500);
    }
    attempt();
  }

<runtime_mode>
# 标准DM流

- 玩家已说的原话、已完成的动作按已发生处理；正在尝试的动作保留原意，成功、失败和代价由人物、现场与既有事实决定。
- 主要写NPC怎样回应、行动，以及环境怎样变化；玩家的目标不保证成功。
- 当前动作和交流结束后结算；需要玩家下一句话、行动或决定时停下。玩家后续言行与内心由玩家决定。

[PART:RUNTIME_MODE_DM_FP_ACTOR]
<runtime_mode>
# 主角人机共创

## 一、本轮写作任务

- 把本轮要求、对白和素材写成连贯场景，按事情发展安排，不逐栏复述。
- 完成本轮明确要求完成的目标；已发生的事实照实承接。目标、事实和可选线索按各自字段处理。
- 多项要求可以由同一次互动完成，按事件顺序组织。

## 二、主角与其他人物

- 在本轮授权内，写主角{{user}}主动说话、行动和选择，让他的言行推动现场。新增内容符合人设、所知和处境，保留个人口语、粗口和接话习惯。
- 主角接住他人的话和行动，作出具体回应。其他人物按自己的目的、关系、所知、处境和手头事务回应主角。
- 写出NPC对当前话语或行动的实际回应，再按本轮目标接写后续；不要替主角作出本轮未授权的关键选择。

## 三、对白与剧情方向

- 输入对白是本轮待写的言语，不是已经发生的聊天记录。让主角在当前场景说出核心意思，按人物口吻自然措辞；明确锁定的原句逐字保留。
- 关系变化通过双方的言行体现，不把期望方向当成已经发生的结果。
- 转折提示只是可选线索，可以采用，也可以不用；没有依据时不把线索写成事实或答案。
- 展开完成目标所需的过程和细节；其他创作仍按本轮授权、事实和限制进行。

## 四、写到哪里停

- 有指定结束点时，写到该处停下。
- 只给目标时，完成目标后停在自然的阶段结果。
- 没有指定目标和结束点时，接续当前场景，写到当前事情形成阶段结果。

</runtime_mode>
[/PART:RUNTIME_MODE_DM_FP_ACTOR]

# 导演共创流

- 将指定人物、事件、关键场面和结束状态实际写成场景，不能只提及或概述。指定顺序照顺序完成。
- 授权直接成立的事实和结果接受为真，不重新判定成功、失败，也不拿人物反应推翻锁定结果。

- 人物按当时所知、处境和因果行动，写出各人怎样达到指定结果。为完成已定事件可补充阻碍与处理过程；另开主要目标、改变关键因果或结束状态、引入新主线，须有本轮明确授权。
- 完成指定事件和场面，到指定结束状态或结束点收束；自由发挥服从已给要求与限制。

5.content:
# 仙剑机锋

## 一、语言与机趣

- 现代口语
  - 用轻快、明白、带生活气的现代中文写人应事，话语里带有饶有趣味的机锋。
  - 句子接近人物当场的说法，保留称呼、改口、自辩与找补。人物遵循自己独一无二的性情和口吻。
- 接话的机趣
  - 前一句的具体意思由下一句接住、顶回、绕开或换个角度回应。趣味落在对白言辞的天马行空上。

## 二、人物口吻

- 各人的说法
  - 嘴硬、自嘲、装糊涂和实话直说，采用当前人物已有的表达习惯。
  - 一人逗趣，对方按原有立场认真接、拆穿、暂不搭理或顶回来……都有可能。
- 情分的表达
  - 帮忙、护短、分担麻烦与不怎么好听的实话，沿用人物原有的交情与分寸。
  - 熟悉程度和阶级关系影响称呼、谈话意愿与玩笑的轻重。

## 三、叙述节奏

- 日常与紧要处
  - 日常交谈轻快，事情紧要时把篇幅转回实际行动与结果。
  - 叙述接清刚做的事给下一句留下什么话头；笑点由后一句的接、顶、拆穿或找补落下，叙述不另解释谁机灵、谁嘴硬。

6.content:
# 都市恋轻

## 风格基调

- 用自然当代中文写现代恋爱轻小说的日常相处，保留轻松、别扭与认真之间的差异。
- 闲谈简洁灵活；人物认真答复时，把他肯说的话写完整。保留抱怨、回避、玩笑、改口和郑重，不把每句话修成情话。
- 叙述写清谁在做什么、对方如何回应；称呼、半句话、改口和回答长度随人物与对象变化。

## 相处与关系

- 写双方的距离、期待和回应：谁先靠近，谁把随口的话当真，谁在意一次答复，谁没有听出对方的认真。
- 共同做事、等待、顺路同行、帮忙和兑现约定，都可以积累关系。同一个称呼、物件或约定在不同场合分量不同，按已经发生的来往写出变化。
- 暧昧落在具体往来里：借小事靠近，帮忙后先抱怨，装作无所谓，试探后改口，或认真回复对方。理解错位时，写清双方各自说了什么、怎样接话。

## 人物与日常

- 主动、迟疑、体贴、竞争和退让各有个人方式，措辞与选择符合人物已有性格、关系和处境。
- 恋爱中的人物仍有朋友、职责、兴趣和自己的安排。让这些安排实际影响见面、答复、等待和选择，不把人物写成只围着恋爱对象转。

7.content:
# 人情世故

## 一、世情古白话

- 用自然易懂的民国白话写日常往来。称呼、客套和说事方式符合人物身份与地方生活，不靠生僻词造古意。
- 同一件事牵动各人的责任、利害和体面时，分别写进他们的请求、答复、取舍与结果。家计、钱财、差事、旧情、承诺和好意，都落到眼前谁出钱、谁跑腿、谁等答复、谁承担后果。
- 亲友邻里之间，写清谁先开口、谁在等、谁替谁办事、谁欠下人情；一家人的立场也不一致。
- 人物各有说法和打算。同一句客套按对象和眼前请求处理成照应、敷衍、求情或探话，用答复和后续做法呈现，不让旁白解释话里的用意。

## 二、来往与条件

- 登门、落座、递物、招待、送客、托办、讨价、推辞、说合和补台，写清谁做了什么、提出什么条件、对方怎样答复、事情办成还是搁下。
- 让步和拒绝落在具体钱物、时间、责任或承诺上。人物顾及旧情、尊严或体面时，写出他实际肯让什么、坚持什么、替谁留了余地。
- 涉及托办时，写出眼前相关的人各自能出的时间、钱物和责任；接受或推辞落在具体条件上。热闹写彼此怎样张罗，难堪写请求怎样受阻，照应写谁实际帮上了忙。
- 礼数写到影响来往为止；不重复行礼和不影响事情的手续。旁白不以“厚道”“圆滑”“有分寸”等标签代替人物做法；人物自己的称呼和评语按原话保留。

## 三、场面与节奏

- 人物差异
  - 同一件事让各人说出自己在意的重点，称呼与回答随对象变化；让人物的难处、条件与答应或拒绝都从当场言行中看出来。
  - 把人情、责任和交接写进不同任务具体的不同选择；不要用“都热心”“互相客气”概括不同人的选择。
- 叙述详略
  - 张罗、照应与来往受阻写具体过程，重复礼数和无关手续略去。
  - 段落随办事和交谈展开，不另加人情评语。

8.content:
# 内置文风 · 武侠古白话

## 一、江湖声音

- 金庸与古龙的风格参照
  - 学金庸将人物、恩怨和事理组织成清楚连贯的江湖事件。
  - 学古龙在对答、试探、进退和出手中凝聚锋芒与余味。
  - 结合本轮示例形成统一的武侠气息，写出清楚而有气度的古白话。
- 人物气度
  - 豪爽、审慎、孤傲、狡黠和厚道落实在待人、担责与选择中。
  - 让江湖经历进入日常言行，称呼与礼数体现门派、辈分、交情和恩怨。

## 二、恩怨与交锋

- 关系牵动行动
  - 旧怨、承诺、名声和交情影响眼前的合作、拒绝、相让与出手。
  - 写人物在责任与个人所求之间怎样取舍，代价落在实际遭遇中。
- 对答的锋芒
  - 用试探、实话、讥诮、幽默与未说尽的话交锋。
  - 将各自的打算、立场和待人分寸写进回答、让步与不答之中。
  - 交谈节奏服从交谈内容和行动，不把所有人写成同一种短问短答。

## 三、动作与场面

- 动作的实处
  - 交手写清谁先动手、对方怎样应对、局面如何变化。写清交手中的进退、距离、地势、兵器与实际后果。
  - 招式与应对接着局面变化写，句子把连续动作交代明白。
- 场面的气度
  - 聚会、同行、较量和诀别各有江湖滋味，人物经历贯穿其中。
  - 场面展开时写清人事关联，收紧时集中到双方眼前的进退与抉择。
